name: local-ai
title: Local AI
description: Run your own AI commands on selected text with Apple's on-device model. No API keys, no subscription.
author: MatloobAltaf

commands.name: run-ai-command
commands.title: AI Commands
commands.description: Run, create and manage your AI commands

commands.name: run-command
commands.title: Run AI Command from Hotkey
commands.description: Runs an AI command from its Quicklink hotkey without opening Raycast. Create a Quicklink in AI Commands, then assign it a hotkey

commands.name: ask-local-ai
commands.title: Ask Local AI
commands.description: Ask the on-device model a quick question

commands.name: chat-with-local-ai
commands.title: Chat with Local AI
commands.description: Have a saved conversation with the on-device model

commands.name: check-setup
commands.title: Check Setup
commands.description: Check that the on-device model is ready to use

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Model for new commands. Check Setup lists the models this Mac offers.

preferences.name: quickAiIncludeSelection
preferences.title: Ask Local AI
preferences.label: Include selected text as context
preferences.description: Include the selected text as context in Ask Local AI.

preferences.name: copySelectionFallback
preferences.title: Selection
preferences.label: Copy selection in apps that don't share it
preferences.description: When an app does not let Raycast read the selected text, copy it and restore your clipboard right after. The copy may appear in clipboard history.

preferences.name: timeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Timeout (Seconds)
preferences.description: How long to wait for the on-device model before giving up.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
